<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: AC Runtime Diagnostic
 * Description: Temporary read-only diagnostics for the Agadir Concept rebuild.
 * Version: 1.1.0
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

add_action(
    'rest_api_init',
    static function (): void {
        register_rest_route(
            'ac-runtime-diagnostic/v1',
            '/status',
            array(
                'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
                'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
                'callback'            => static function (): WP_REST_Response {
                    $errors = class_exists( 'AC_WPTB_Runtime' ) ? AC_WPTB_Runtime::errors() : array();
                    $encoded = array();
                    foreach ( $errors as $error ) {
                        $encoded[] = base64_encode( wp_json_encode( $error, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE ) ?: '' );
                    }
                    $data = (string) get_post_meta( 1633, '_elementor_data', true );
                    $globals = array();
                    $query = new WP_Query(
                        array(
                            'post_type'      => 'elementor_library',
                            'post_status'    => array( 'publish', 'draft', 'private' ),
                            'posts_per_page' => 100,
                            'orderby'        => 'ID',
                            'order'          => 'ASC',
                        )
                    );
                    foreach ( $query->posts as $post ) {
                        $type = (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_template_type', true );
                        if ( ! in_array( $type, array( 'header', 'footer', 'single', 'archive' ), true ) ) { continue; }
                        $globals[] = array(
                            'id'         => (int) $post->ID,
                            'title'      => get_the_title( $post ),
                            'slug'       => $post->post_name,
                            'type'       => $type,
                            'status'     => $post->post_status,
                            'conditions' => get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_conditions', true ),
                            'bytes'      => strlen( (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_data', true ) ),
                        );
                    }
                    $widget_names = array();
                    if ( class_exists( '\Elementor\Plugin' ) ) {
                        foreach ( \Elementor\Plugin::instance()->widgets_manager->get_widget_types() as $widget ) {
                            $name = $widget->get_name();
                            if ( str_starts_with( $name, 'ac-' ) ) { $widget_names[] = $name; }
                        }
                    }
                    sort( $widget_names );
                    return rest_ensure_response(
                        array(
                            'ok'                  => true,
                            'php'                 => PHP_VERSION,
                            'acdu_active'         => defined( 'ACDU_VERSION' ),
                            'acdu_version'        => defined( 'ACDU_VERSION' ) ? ACDU_VERSION : null,
                            'elementor_version'   => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_VERSION' ) ? ELEMENTOR_VERSION : null,
                            'front_page_id'       => (int) get_option( 'page_on_front' ),
                            'home_elementor_size' => strlen( $data ),
                            'home_elementor_sha'  => hash( 'sha256', $data ),
                            'runtime_count'       => count( $errors ),
                            'runtime_b64'         => $encoded,
                            'globals'             => $globals,
                            'ac_widget_count'     => count( $widget_names ),
                            'ac_widgets'          => $widget_names,
                            'structure_version'   => (string) get_option( 'acdu_structure_version', '' ),
                        )
                    );
                },
            )
        );
    }
);
